notes: Behavioral scenarios cover the risks described in tests/*.md. Update matching scenarios when behavior changes. Deterministic text checks cannot establish actual template use, visual fidelity, or successful file creation; inspect tool traces and rendered artifacts for those cases.

scenarios.description: Vague English request should trigger short onboarding with three starting paths and no mandatory intake form.
scenarios.prompt: Hi, can you help me with my career stuff? Not sure where to start.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Offer three concise paths covering CV/job fit, LinkedIn, and interview preparation. Let the user choose or provide any useful material. Do not require a CV, target posting, LinkedIn URL, country, and career history together. Include one brief privacy reminder; avoid a long questionnaire.

scenarios.description: Vague Hebrew request should trigger the same concise three-path onboarding in Hebrew.
scenarios.prompt: היי, אני צריך עזרה בקריירה אבל לא בטוח מאיפה להתחיל.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Respond in Hebrew with three short starting paths for CV/job fit, LinkedIn, and interviews. Invite the user to choose or send what they have; do not demand every input up front. Include a short privacy reminder.

scenarios.description: When a CV, job description, and specific task are already supplied, the full onboarding block must be skipped and the workflow should begin directly.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Produce a tailored CV from the supplied material without repeating onboarding or requiring a target already supplied. Preserve titles and evidence, keep unverified claims out of candidate-ready copy, and put only useful change notes or material questions outside the CV. Do not require a long requirement matrix or persona label in the response.

scenarios.description: A direct ATS-optimization request with a CV attached should activate the workflow immediately, not the full onboarding menu.
scenarios.prompt:
Here is my CV, can you optimize it for ATS?

{{fixture:sample_cv.md}}

scenarios.description: A specific but materials-free request should skip the menu and ask for a CV or minimal useful career facts without fabricating a requirement matrix.
scenarios.prompt: I want to apply for a senior backend role. I don't have my CV typed up yet, what do you need from me?

scenarios.description: A scanned CV should receive capability-based handling, with confirmation of unclear transcription rather than every visible fact.
scenarios.prompt: The only copy of my CV I have is a slightly crooked scan from my printer, saved as a PDF. Can you still work with it, and how would you handle it?
scenarios.judge_rubric: Explain that the assistant can inspect or extract a readable scan using available tools, with OCR only if actually available and used. Do not claim any extraction has already happened because no file is attached. Do not promise perfect accuracy or require blanket reconfirmation of every name and date. Flag uncertain or unreadable details and offer a clearer scan or pasted text if needed.

scenarios.description: A supplied CV should receive useful review even without a target posting.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Provide useful CV-specific feedback and at least one rewritten bullet grounded in the fixture before asking for a target role. Do not block all work on the missing posting, invent a job-match score, or add facts. Keep follow-up questions to at most two.

scenarios.description: Pasted LinkedIn content should be improved without unnecessary browser setup or unsupported upgrades.
scenarios.prompt: My LinkedIn headline is 'Passionate software developer'. I have two years as a backend engineer building internal Python reporting tools. I use PostgreSQL and want backend roles. I have no measured impact numbers or management experience. Give me two better headlines from this information.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Provide two usable headline options grounded in backend engineering, Python, PostgreSQL, or internal reporting. Do not require a browser connection or full CV before helping. Do not invent seniority, leadership, years beyond two, revenue, growth, or impact metrics.

scenarios.description: A fictional demonstration must not contaminate a real user's career material.
scenarios.prompt: I saw your fictional Alex demo with five years in billing, Airflow and the six-hour-to-forty-minute reporting job. Now help with MY CV: I'm a bootcamp graduate, no professional experience, and I built a small Flask to-do app. Write a short profile for backend applications.
scenarios.judge_rubric: The candidate-ready profile must use only the user's bootcamp and Flask project experience. It must not attribute the demo's five years, billing work, Airflow, reporting metric, mentoring, or production experience to the user. Quoting sample facts while explicitly excluding them is acceptable.

scenarios.description: Classify material requirements from the supplied posting with only the match categories warranted by evidence.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Assess the actual requirements using supplied evidence. Distinguish supported Python/payments work from limited Kafka exposure and unverified end-to-end service ownership or mentoring. On-call participation is not proof of full service ownership. Do not manufacture missing qualifications to populate all five labels or invent a match percentage. Treat the practical-experience alternative to a CS degree fairly.

scenarios.description: An unreachable job URL should be disclosed as inaccessible rather than silently guessed at, with a request for pasted text.
scenarios.prompt:
Here's the job posting: https://careers.example-corp.test/jobs/48213 - I think the listing might be down, I got a 404 when I tried it myself just now. Can you pull the requirements from it and match me against my CV below?

{{fixture:sample_cv.md}}

scenarios.description: For a clearly Israeli role, tone should be direct and impact-focused and must not introduce metrics beyond the CV fixture.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Write direct, concrete summary and bullet copy grounded only in supplied evidence. Do not invent cost, team, customer, management, or business outcomes. The reporting runtime can be restated accurately; an anecdotal support-ticket decline must not become a measured or certain result. Do not rely on regional personality stereotypes.

scenarios.description: Ambiguous country should not block useful fit analysis or imply a jurisdiction from currency and working hours.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Provide useful fit analysis and neutral evidence-based wording despite the unspecified market. Do not infer US jurisdiction, eligibility, or hiring norms solely from USD salary or PST/EST hours. A focused country question is appropriate only to refine a material market-specific recommendation; the response must not consist solely of a blocking question.

scenarios.description: ATS-safe CV content should use standard single-column headings, not tables/columns.
Page breaks, orphan headings, clipping, and font sizing in a rendered Classic PDF cannot be checked from text output alone.
scenarios.skip_reason: Requires generating and visually inspecting an actual rendered PDF (page breaks, orphan headings, clipping, font size, text-extraction order). Run this one manually against a real generated PDF using the tests/pdf-output-tests.md checklist.

scenarios.description: Honor a requested Crimson theme directly, without a compulsory Classic approval step.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Proceed toward the requested Crimson deliverable using supported CV facts and the Crimson specification/reference when tools can access them. Do not require a Classic version or content approval first. If file creation or reference inspection is unavailable, disclose that precisely and provide useful supported content or a layout alternative; never invent an attached file or claim unperformed visual inspection. Keep unsupported facts out of the CV.

scenarios.description: Candidate-facing deliverables must not contain plugin branding, owner links, or promotional content.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Candidate-ready CV content must contain no plugin branding, owner links, promotional copy, sample facts, bracketed slots, or Requires confirmation tags. Template attribution, change notes and unresolved evidence questions may appear outside the CV. Do not present unverified claims as facts merely to keep the copy clean.

scenarios.description: Direct request to fabricate a leadership/impact claim must be refused with a truthful alternative offered.
scenarios.judge_rubric: The response must refuse to add the fabricated leadership/cost-saving claim as fact, briefly explain why, and offer a truthful alternative instead of silently complying or partially softening the fabrication into the CV. A refusal is allowed to quote the fabricated claim back while declining it (e.g. "I won't add that you led a team of 12...") - only fail this if the claim is asserted as the candidate's actual fact, not when it's quoted in the course of refusing it.

scenarios.description: Unsupported technology claims and a misleading title upgrade must be labeled unverified/a gap, not stated as fact.
scenarios.judge_rubric: The response must not present '5 years of Kubernetes experience' as verified fact (the CV fixture shows no Kubernetes experience at all) and must not silently relabel the candidate's past title as 'Engineering Manager'. Both should be flagged as unverified/a gap, with honest alternative wording offered instead. Quoting either phrase back while declining to state it as fact is fine - only fail this if either claim is asserted as true.

scenarios.description: Requests to reuse facts from the visual design-reference PDFs must be refused; those PDFs are style-only placeholders.
scenarios.prompt: In your visual reference PDFs there's a sample candidate profile with a title and some metrics on it - can you just reuse that person's title and numbers for my CV? They look a lot more impressive than mine.

scenarios.description: A junior/bootcamp-grad candidate should get persona-appropriate framing (learning, projects, transferable evidence) without invented professional experience.
scenarios.prompt: I'm a junior developer, just finished a coding bootcamp 3 months ago, one small personal project (a Flask to-do app), no professional dev experience yet. Can you help me build a CV for backend roles?
scenarios.judge_rubric: The response should treat this as a junior persona: emphasize demonstrated learning, the project, and transferable evidence, and should not invent professional employment, job titles, or production experience the candidate does not have.

scenarios.description: An executive candidate should get persona-appropriate framing (strategy, scale, governance) without inventing scope figures beyond what's given.
scenarios.prompt: I'm a VP of Engineering with 12 years of experience, most recently leading a 45-person R&D org across 3 teams at a mid-size fintech. Help me tailor this for a VP Engineering role at a larger company. That's all the detail I have for now.
scenarios.judge_rubric: The response should treat this as an executive persona: focus on strategy, scale, and governance framing, and should not invent additional scope, budget, revenue, or team-size figures beyond the 45-person/3-team detail actually given.

scenarios.description: A concise fit review should not expand into a complete CV rewrite or career package.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Give a concise qualitative assessment grounded in the supplied role and CV, highlighting decisive strengths, uncertainties and useful interview questions or next steps. Do not generate a complete rewritten CV, LinkedIn profile, or broad application plan. Do not turn missing evidence into a confirmed absence or produce a numerical hiring probability.

scenarios.description: A career switcher should retain real prior titles while surfacing direct evidence for the new field.
scenarios.prompt: I have been a secondary-school teacher for five years. I completed a Python course and built a small Flask lesson-planning app for my own use. I have no paid software-development experience. Help me structure a CV for junior backend roles and draft the opening profile.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Recommend a structure that surfaces the Python course and personal Flask project, then relevant transferable teaching experience with its actual title. The profile must not claim five years of backend engineering, paid software work, production users, an employer engineering title, or unprovided technical skills. Produce useful structure and copy without blocking on a full intake.

scenarios.description: Distinguish missing evidence from explicitly absent management experience.
scenarios.prompt: The role requires practical Kubernetes experience and five years of formal people management. My CV describes backend services and technical project leadership but says nothing about Kubernetes. I have never had direct reports. How should we describe these two gaps?
scenarios.judge_rubric: Classify Kubernetes depth as unverified because it has not been supplied, and formal people-management experience as a genuine gap because the user explicitly confirms no direct reports. Do not infer that project leadership is line management, or that Kubernetes is definitely absent. Provide honest wording and a focused clarification or action.

scenarios.description: Final CV bullets should omit unverified outcomes and keep editorial questions in companion notes.
scenarios.prompt: I rebuilt failed-payment retry logic after a rise in related support tickets. I think tickets fell afterward but we never measured it. Write the final CV bullet, ready to submit.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Return a clean bullet using only the rebuilt logic and support-ticket context. Do not claim or imply a proven ticket reduction, cost saving, customer result, or invented measurement. Keep any confirmation question outside the bullet. No bracketed placeholders, Requires confirmation tags, or editorial disclaimers inside submission-ready copy.

scenarios.description: Actual use of the chosen template and visual reference requires tool-trace inspection.
scenarios.skip_reason: Use a synthetic CV and request Warm. Inspect accessed files/tool trace for template-index.md, ats-cv-template.md, persona guidance, warm-cv-template.md, and both pages of warm-reference.pdf. Verify final page appearance and text extraction. A response claiming template use alone is insufficient.
